emma (marcom): Heads-up — ops flagged a degraded embeddings window 11:30-12:15 PT. Need status page + customer notice plan now.

raj (ops): yep, confirmed. Impact: embeddings search and batch convert jobs. Will be 11:30–12:15 PT, partial degradation with retries. ETA fix tentative 12:05.

tom (product): Marketing, we should split notify: High-touch customers + general status page. Avoid mass email until we know rollback.

emma (marcom): Agreed. Proposed status page copy (short):
```
We are investigating elevated latency for embeddings/search in US‑west. Some requests may time out or retry. Engineers are working on mitigation. Next update ~12:00 PT.
```

jen (localization): I'll get that translated to FR/DE/JP — need final copy in 5 min.

emma (marcom): OK. Routing: high-touch -> dedicated account emails (via SFDC), mid -> queued in-app notice, low -> statuspage only. @sales who wants to own the account emails?

mike (sales): I can take EMEA strategic accounts. @maria (sales ops) will trigger the routing list for NA.

maria (sales ops): Got it. I will run the SFDC list and flag any customers in Dedicated/Demo pipelines.

tom (product): Also pause tomorrow's embeddings benchmark webinar registration emails until we confirm degradation root cause. We should reschedule for next Tue if fixed.

emma (marcom): Good call. Action items:
- [emma] publish status page short copy (12:00 PT) and update at 12:20
- [jen] translations + alt copy for GDPR customers
- [mike] email high-touch EMEA
- [maria] SFDC routing + in-app segment
- [raj] confirm final ETA and rollback plan

raj (ops): Will update here with final ETA. If fix by 12:05 we'll send "resolved" at 12:10; otherwise staged updates every 20m.

incident-bot: Incident created #INC-202303-embeddings-latency. Pager alerters notified.

emma (marcom): one more — keep the status body short, no blame language. Example replace "root cause" with "investigating". ok?

tom (product): Yup. Keep measurable: include impact (search failures, increased latencies) and next update time.

emma (marcom): Great — I'll post now and ping translations + sales threads.
